test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**with**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank describes how the old lady was walking in relation to her basket.
 
• The phrase needs to indicate that she had her basket with her while walking.
 
• "**With**" is the correct preposition used to indicate accompaniment or having something present. "Walking with her basket" means she was carrying or had her basket while walking.
 
• The other options ("beside", "in", "at") do not fit the context logically or grammatically.

 

Complete Passage: *That was a jolly story 1. which__ Arthur Ransome told the other day in one of his messages from Petrograd, a place in Russia. A stout old lady was walking 2. __with__ her basket down the middle of a street to the 3. _____ confusion of the traffic and with no small peril to herself. It was pointed 4. _____ to her that the 5. _____ was the place for the foot passengers, but she replied, “I’m going to walk where I like. We’ve got liberty now.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Beside: next to; at the side of.
 
• In: expressing position within a space.
 
• At: expressing location or arrival in a place.
